TECHNICAL
WHAT: Dock icon visibility and `NSApplication setActivationPolicy` have no effect in `tauri dev` mode — the process runs as a bare binary from cargo, not a bundled `.app`
HOW TO TEST: Build with `./scripts/build-staging.sh` then open the `.app` from `src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/`
GOTCHA 1: If the dev server (`npm run tauri dev`) is running simultaneously, the single_instance plugin intercepts the launch and focuses the dev window — kill dev server before testing staging build
GOTCHA 2: The build script must bundle frontend assets — a bare `cargo build` + copy won't work, use the full tauri build pipeline
WHY: macOS dock icon and activation policy are properties of `.app` bundles, not standalone binaries
